title: Recipe
description: A recipe Sous can cook from. Extraction produces it, the brain reads it, the app shows it.

id.description: Set by the brain when the recipe is saved. Leave it out when posting a new recipe.

slug.description: Set by the brain from the title, unique per user. Names the recipe's vault note.

source_url.description: Where the recipe came from, usually the Instagram post.

steps.description: In cooking order. go_to_step uses the zero-based index into this list.

Times.description: Rough times in whole minutes. Any of them can be missing.

quantity.description: How much, as a number (0.5 for half). Missing for "to taste" or "a pinch".

unit.description: Unit for the quantity, e.g. "g", "tbsp", "cloves". Missing for countable things like "2 eggs".

note.description: Prep or wording that doesn't fit the other fields, e.g. "finely sliced" or "to taste".

text.description: The instruction, written to be read aloud.

done_cue.description: What done looks, smells or sounds like, e.g. "deep golden and jammy".

duration_seconds.description: How long the step usually takes, when the recipe says. Handy for start_timer.
